arcs.title: The Six Remaining Ducks of Elspeth Holt
arcs.summary: Day 1: Mrs. Holt has confirmed she has six more ducks at home, each already hatted. Duck the sixth — a tricorn with a feather clasp — arrived today. She has not indicated a schedule. The Jeep is receptive. Steve has walked with her twice now. The new arc tracks the gradual arrival of the remaining ducks, each hat more characterful than the last, building toward a moment where either the collection is complete or Mrs. Holt reveals something further about her history with the ridge and its visitors. No drama — warmth and accumulation.
